actor.mode-claim.definition: A claim-local provenance slot for an operation mode associated with the claim record, not a mode inferred from its source, card or run.
actor.mode-claim.applicability: Applies to the claim record and its own revision when a populated actor mapping is directly recorded; the selected native claim exposes only the template object/null state.
actor.mode-claim.observed_state: One template claim has actor.mode null; no populated claim actor.mode occurs; parent absence is not observed for the selected claim.
actor.mode-claim.reader_consequence: Render the unfilled claim-local provenance limitation; do not call it source authorship, verification or a closed enum.
actor.mode-claim.extractor_consequence: Preserve null and record a populated mode only from direct claim-scoped evidence; do not inherit card, source or run mode.
actor.mode-claim.query_consequence: A query for claim mode must be scoped to claim revisions and distinguish null from absent or a populated value.
actor.mode-claim.migration_consequence: Do not derive a claim mode from root identity, source refs, card refs or run refs; retain the unresolved state.
unresolved_questions: What activity class, if any, does a populated claim actor.mode describe?
Is a claim actor mode applicable outside direct extraction evidence?

actor.mode-competency-question.definition: A standalone competency-question-local operation-mode slot, distinct from the CQ roles that describe requirement, coverage, answerability, verification or retrieval use.
actor.mode-competency-question.applicability: Applies only to the CQ record and revision when directly populated; the selected template is null and the synthetic CQ parent is absent.
actor.mode-competency-question.observed_state: One template CQ has actor.mode null and the synthetic cq-coverage witness has no actor parent; no populated CQ mode occurs.
actor.mode-competency-question.reader_consequence: Keep CQ roles and actor mode visibly separate; display parent absence rather than converting it to a null child.
actor.mode-competency-question.extractor_consequence: Record a mode only from direct CQ provenance; do not populate it from question text, component refs, roles, coverage or answerability.
actor.mode-competency-question.query_consequence: CQ mode queries must not treat roles or coverage as actor.mode matches; absent and null require separate predicates.
actor.mode-competency-question.migration_consequence: Preserve CQ role arrays and actor.mode independently; no migration enum or inherited card actor is authorized.
unresolved_questions: Does a populated CQ actor.mode describe question authoring, inspection or another activity?
What evidence would connect a CQ mode to a run without conflating the constructs?

actor.mode-concept-card.definition: A card-revision operation-mode observation attached to the recorded card actor mapping, not proof of every activity that produced or reviewed the card.
actor.mode-concept-card.applicability: Applies to each concept-card revision with a direct actor mapping; 21 generated cards record agent-direct, while one template is null and nine selected parents are absent.
actor.mode-concept-card.observed_state: All 21 populated cards use agent-direct across pilot, rich and teaching families; this repeated value is an observed label, not a canonical vocabulary or global activity claim.
actor.mode-concept-card.reader_consequence: Show agent-direct with card family/revision context when present, and show null/absent as provenance limitations rather than source-author or verification labels.
actor.mode-concept-card.extractor_consequence: Preserve exact mode spelling and parent/child state; do not normalize card actors across families or infer the mode for embedded claims, CQs or runs.
actor.mode-concept-card.query_consequence: Scope mode lookup to card kind, family and revision; repeated spelling is not a principal join or proof of source identity.
actor.mode-concept-card.migration_consequence: Retain agent-direct, null and absent states with their revision context; do not impose a requiredness rule, vocabulary or inheritance policy.
unresolved_questions: Does agent-direct describe the extraction act, the card authoring act or both?
Which future evidence can distinguish card actor mode from worker or run mode?

actor.mode-extraction-run.definition: A run-local operation-mode slot for the actor directly recorded on an extraction run, distinct from worker_scope.mode and output-card modes.
actor.mode-extraction-run.applicability: Applies to an extraction-run revision with direct actor evidence; the selected run has only template null and synthetic parent-absent witnesses.
actor.mode-extraction-run.observed_state: One run template has actor.mode null and two synthetic run traces have no actor parent; worker scope in those examples does not populate actor.mode.
actor.mode-extraction-run.reader_consequence: Keep run actor mode distinct from worker mode, method and output-card labels; report the selected run actor as unpopulated.
actor.mode-extraction-run.extractor_consequence: Record the actual run actor and scope only when directly observed; do not copy worker_scope.mode or card actor mode into the run.
actor.mode-extraction-run.query_consequence: Run mode queries must select actor.mode, not worker_scope.mode or output refs; no-match and absent parent remain observable outcomes.
actor.mode-extraction-run.migration_consequence: Preserve absent/null run state and worker trace separately; defer any requiredness or cross-record inheritance rule.
unresolved_questions: What event/class does a populated run actor.mode describe?
How should run mode relate to actual worker scopes and output card modes?

actor.role-claim.definition: A claim-local activity-role slot for direct claim provenance, not the assertion kind, source author, verifier or operator role.
actor.role-claim.applicability: Applies to a claim actor mapping when directly recorded; the selected claim has only the template null child.
actor.role-claim.observed_state: The claim template exposes actor.role null; no populated claim role occurs in the selected parsed population.
actor.role-claim.reader_consequence: Do not label a claim as extractor, author or verifier merely because its template contains the slot.
actor.role-claim.extractor_consequence: Preserve null and populate only from direct claim-scoped provenance; do not inherit a card actor.role or source author.
actor.role-claim.query_consequence: Role lookup is claim-kind and revision scoped; assertion_kind, reviewer and operator records are not actor.role substitutes.
actor.role-claim.migration_consequence: Keep claim actor.role unfilled and preserve the distinction from lifecycle result roles; no enum or join is selected.
unresolved_questions: Which activity roles are applicable to claims, if any?
What direct witness would warrant a claim role without collapsing review authority?

actor.role-competency-question.definition: A CQ-local activity-role slot distinct from the CQ's roles array, which describes requirement, coverage, answerability, verification or retrieval use.
actor.role-competency-question.applicability: Applies to a CQ actor mapping when directly recorded; the selected template is null and the synthetic CQ has no actor parent.
actor.role-competency-question.observed_state: The template role child is null; the standalone CQ's roles/component references do not populate actor.role; no populated CQ actor.role occurs.
actor.role-competency-question.reader_consequence: Render CQ roles as question-use metadata, not as actor role; preserve the absent parent as an explicit limitation.
actor.role-competency-question.extractor_consequence: Do not turn requirement/coverage roles, component refs or answerability into actor.role; record only direct CQ provenance.
actor.role-competency-question.query_consequence: CQ actor.role and CQ roles require different fields and predicates; a role match in one must not satisfy the other.
actor.role-competency-question.migration_consequence: Preserve both surfaces independently and defer vocabulary, requiredness and authority joins.
unresolved_questions: What activity role could a standalone CQ actor carry?
How would a CQ actor role relate to the role of a run or reviewer without inheritance by shape?

actor.role-concept-card.definition: A card-revision activity-role observation for the recorded actor mapping; in the selected generated cards the observed label is extractor, not source authorship or verification authority.
actor.role-concept-card.applicability: Applies to populated card actor mappings by revision and family; 21 cards record extractor, one template is null and nine selected parents are absent.
actor.role-concept-card.observed_state: All 21 populated cards use extractor with agent-direct; codex-cc occurs in four pilot cards and codex in 17 rich/teaching cards, without evidence that labels are globally equivalent.
actor.role-concept-card.reader_consequence: Show extractor as the recorded card activity label with revision/family context; do not call it source author, verifier, operator or unique principal.
actor.role-concept-card.extractor_consequence: Retain exact label spelling, family and parent state; do not normalize codex-cc/codex or inherit the label into embedded claims, CQs or runs.
actor.role-concept-card.query_consequence: Role queries must scope by card revision/family and distinguish actor.role from lifecycle verifier/validator fields; repeated spelling is not identity proof.
actor.role-concept-card.migration_consequence: Preserve exact role labels and null/absent distinctions; no global role vocabulary, requiredness or principal registry is adopted.
unresolved_questions: Does extractor describe card generation, source extraction or a composite activity?
What evidence would distinguish an actor role from worker role and review authority?

actor.role-extraction-run.definition: A run-local activity-role slot for the directly recorded run actor, distinct from worker roles, method identity and output-card actor roles.
actor.role-extraction-run.applicability: Applies to an extraction-run actor mapping when directly observed; the selected run has template null and synthetic absent-parent states only.
actor.role-extraction-run.observed_state: No populated run actor.role occurs; worker-scope roles in synthetic run examples remain worker-scope evidence rather than actor.role.
actor.role-extraction-run.reader_consequence: Keep run actor role unpopulated and separate from source-scope, claim-support or integration worker roles.
actor.role-extraction-run.extractor_consequence: Record run actor.role only from direct run evidence; do not infer it from worker_outputs, output card labels or method/prompt fields.
actor.role-extraction-run.query_consequence: Run role predicates select actor.role and revision, not worker role arrays; missing input and no-match remain distinct diagnostics.
actor.role-extraction-run.migration_consequence: Preserve absent/null run role and worker trace separately; defer any cross-record role inheritance or requiredness policy.
unresolved_questions: What role vocabulary, if any, is appropriate for an extraction run actor?
How should run actor role relate to worker and output-card roles while preserving activity boundaries?
